azure-az-305-s1.1-11.statement: The instrumentation key in an Application Insights connection string acts as a security key against forged telemetry.
azure-az-305-s1.1-11.explanation: The instrumentation key only identifies the Application Insights resource and isn't a security key. To reject unauthenticated telemetry, disable local authentication and require Microsoft Entra ID.

azure-az-305-s1.3-04.statement: Cost Management tag inheritance copies resource group tags onto the resources in the group.
azure-az-305-s1.3-04.explanation: Tag inheritance applies subscription and resource group tags to child resource usage records, not to the resources themselves, so costs can be grouped without tagging every resource.
